author: ContinueRQLS10b
headline: For the explicitly defined family F of 100 planes (the four U-invariant planes P_tau and all WH translates): the 100 planes are distinct; the b-couple compatibility sets are nonempty exactly when tau' = -tau and w' - w lies in L_b, and are then circles lambda * A_0 (A_0 = D_w Z^c' Q K D_w^-1 for Z, transported by U, U^2 to T, X), valid for every frame; consequently every couple flips tau and no W8 solution of any cardinality has all four representative planes in F (triangle parity). All W8/E1 facts used are re-derived; flatness of F is not used.
execution: Written mathematics only; tools /bin/date, shasum, chmod and file read/write/edit. No scripts, assertions, symbolic computation, numerics as proof, other CLI, tests, imports or nested agents. Before its 0444 freeze, 01 received edits removing an unused garbled equivalence and a garbled sentence in Lemma 10 and Theorem 12 (Z), and correcting 6sqrt5/1200 to 24sqrt5/1200 in Lemma 8; after freezing nothing was changed.
non_claims: no statement about flat planes outside F or W8 solutions using them
single author, unreviewed; parent owns review and verdict
